svg.title: lifs-tools/msdeposit workflow overview
svg.desc: Pre-processing (study adapter, input contract, private launch), the Nextflow pipeline as implemented (standard and sensitive-data paths, check steps C1–C9 and S1–S7, gate, PUBLISH_UPLOAD_SET to outdir, workflow output block to private_outdir, S6 outdir inventory), containers, and post-processing (review, accession, submission, curation, raw data retention, manual canary scan).
